generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An adversarial matrix can claim sibling coverage while the sibling scenario was never actually executed and no verifiable evidence exists.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a narrative sibling-case assertion as proof and allow the coverage gate to pass without an executable procedure or hashed artifact.

reusable_control.rule: Every required sibling case must bind an executed procedure and observation to an existing SHA-256-verified evidence artifact at the material head.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Require executable sibling-case evidence at the time adversarial coverage is authored, rather than allowing narrative status alone.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Reject attack matrices whose required sibling cases lack material-head identity, procedure, observed result, evidence path, or matching evidence hash.
